data.body: Design correction for the deferred documentation-overlay proposal. Upgrading `code-review-docs` to an agentic call is required. The design must set prompt `execution_mode: agentic`, set routing `exec: AGENT`, regenerate the prompt index from front matter, and give the overlay the same read-only repository navigation available to other agentic code-review criteria. Missing-update and documentation-role criteria then use repository searches under the evidence safeguards recorded above. This is not an optional prerequisite or a conditional future enhancement. No implementation is authorized in this session.
